SUMMARY.md: API providing information about characters, locations, and episodes from the Rick and Morty show. Supports GraphQL and REST endpoints for querying data.
List of characters who have been last seen in this location
List of characters who have been seen in this episode
List of episodes in which this character appeared
The air date of the episode
The code of the episode (for example, S01E01)
The dimension in which the location is located
Time at which the character was created in the database
Time at which the episode was created in the database
Time at which the location was created in the database
